background.description: White paper, hand-written in black ink, in English, not in capital letters

notes: Verified against the official CRP PO/MT-XVI notification (Annexure III): hand-written declaration on white paper in black ink, in English only, NOT in capital letters, 800x400 pixels at 200 DPI (i.e. 10cm x 5cm), 50-100 KB, JPEG. Write out this exact text by hand before photographing/scanning it: "I, __________ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." If you can't write, you may get the text typed and put your left thumb impression below it instead.
